title: Quiz: Sorting and Searching
description: Check your understanding of Sorting and Searching.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in Assembly?
questions.explanation: In Assembly, ; marks a comment. Block comments use ; (line comments only).

questions.question: Why is binary search faster than linear search?
options: It halves the remaining items each step
It runs on a faster CPU
questions.correctAnswer: It halves the remaining items each step
questions.explanation: Binary search needs sorted data and takes O(log n) time.

questions.question: True or False: Binary search requires the data to be sorted first.
Fill in the blank: items.sort()  // arrange in ___ order
questions.explanation: Sort orders elements for predictable access.

questions.question: In Assembly, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
